// A retry wrapper with jittered backoff. fetch is retried on 5xx and on
// network errors, never on 4xx: retrying those just burns quota.

const BASE_DELAY_MS = 250;
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;

/* sleep resolves after ms, so the await in the loop reads linearly. */
function sleep(ms) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}) {
  let lastError = null;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, options);
      if (response.status >= 500) {
        throw new Error(`server returned ${response.status}`);
      }
      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error;
      const jitter = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.85;
      await sleep(BASE_DELAY_MS * 2 ** (attempt - 1) * jitter);
    }
  }
  throw lastError;
}

// Usage: pull every page until the cursor runs out.
async function pullAll(startUrl) {
  const items = [];
  let cursor = startUrl;
  while (cursor) {
    const body = await fetchWithRetry(cursor, {
      headers: { accept: "application/json" },
    });
    const page = await body.json();
    items.push(...page.items);
    cursor = page.next;
  }
  return items;
}

export { fetchWithRetry, pullAll };
